title: Linear extension by zero
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring and $j\colon U\to X$ an open immersion.
With $\Lambda_X=p_X^*\Lambda$ ([sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]) and module
objects as in [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], the *linear extension by zero*

$$
j^{\mathrm{lin}}_!\colon\Mod_{j^*\Lambda_X}\to\Mod_{\Lambda_X}
$$

is the linearization ([sk-def-sfb-transport]) of the extension by zero $j^{\Ab}_!$ of
abelian sheaves through the projection formula of [lem-sfb-open-projection-formula]:
it sends a $j^*\Lambda_X$-module $M$ to $j^{\Ab}_!M$ with the $\Lambda_X$-action

$$
\Lambda_X\otimes j^{\Ab}_!M\cong j^{\Ab}_!(j^*\Lambda_X\otimes M)
\xrightarrow{\;j^{\Ab}_!(\text{action})\;}j^{\Ab}_!M .
$$

Its underlying sheaf functor is $j^{\Ab}_!$, it is exact, and it is left adjoint to
the transport $\operatorname{mapMod}(j^*_{\Ab})\colon\Mod_{\Lambda_X}\to
\Mod_{j^*\Lambda_X}$.

proof.text: Put $\mathcal C=\Sh(U_{\mathrm{proét}},\Ab)$, $\mathcal D=\Sh(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\Ab)$, $B=\Lambda_X$, $P=j^{\Ab}_!$ and $S=j^*_{\Ab}$. By [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], $B$ is a monoid object. By [sk-def-sfb-finite-lower-shriek], $P$ is exact and $P\dashv S$; [def-sfb-finite-upper-star-monoidal] makes $S$ strong monoidal.
The canonical maps for this adjunction are invertible by [lem-sfb-open-projection-formula]. Thus [def-sfb-adjunction-projection-formula] supplies their coherent projection formula $\pi$.

Apply [def-sfb-modobj-linearization] to $\pi$ and $B$. Define $j^{\mathrm{lin}}_!=P_B$. Its action is $P(\gamma_M)\circ\pi^{-1}_{B,M}$ and its morphism map is $a\mapsto Pa$. This is precisely the displayed construction, with source $\Mod_{SB}$; the same node gives $U_B\circ P_B=P\circ U_{SB}$.
With these same $P,S,B,\pi$, [def-sfb-modobj-linearization-transport-adjunction] gives $P_B\dashv\operatorname{mapMod}(S)$, the required adjunction.

The sites are small under [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]; [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheaves-enough-injectives] makes $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ abelian. By [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-closed], their tensor products are additive and $SB\otimes-$ and $B\otimes-$ are right exact.

By [lem-sfb-modobj-abelian], both module categories are abelian: step 5 supplies additive tensors and finite-colimit preservation by tensoring with $SB$ and $B$. By [lem-sfb-modobj-forget-left-exact], their forgetful functors $U_{SB}$ and $U_B$ preserve finite limits.

The functor $U_B$ reflects isomorphisms. Indeed, if a $B$-linear $f\colon M\to N$ has underlying inverse $g$, its linearity $f\gamma_M=\gamma_N(B\otimes f)$ implies $g\gamma_N=\gamma_M(B\otimes g)$ by composing on the left with $g$ and on the right with $B\otimes g$. Thus $g$ is a module morphism and the same inverse identities hold in the module category.

Apply [lem-sfb-conservative-left-exact-reflects-finite-limits] to $U_B$: step 6 supplies finite limits and their preservation, and step 7 supplies reflection of isomorphisms. Hence $U_B$ reflects finite limits. Step 3 identifies $U_B P_B=P U_{SB}$, which preserves finite limits by steps 1 and 6 (apply the two functors successively to a limit cone). Now [lem-sfb-finite-limit-preservation-cancellation] gives preservation of finite limits by $P_B$.

The lifted adjunction of step 4 and [lem-weil-pbc-left-adjoint-preserves-colimits] give finite-colimit preservation by $P_B$. Its source and target are abelian by step 6, so [lem-sfb-preserving-colimits-additive] gives additivity. Together with step 8 this proves exactness, in the sense of [def-galois-exact-functor].

lean.note: Exact existing published upstream construction, read with scompile.py --source. Section binders are Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}, [MonObj Λ], [IsCommMonObj Λ], {U X : Scheme.{u}}, j : U ⟶ X and [IsOpenImmersion j]. The definition is the projection-formula mapModLeft lift of the actual abelian extension-by-zero adjunction at condensedRingObj Λ X. Its action is the inverse canonical projection-formula map followed by the extension of the module action, and its map on morphisms is the abelian extension-by-zero map. Companion declarations listed here give the equality after forgetting, adjunction to upperStar.mapMod, additivity and preservation of finite limits and colimits. No scalar change to Λ_U is performed. This is an existing statement binding, not a claim that every upstream proof dependency is closed.
